newsitem.title: JAPAN: Maruco shares ask-only on lower profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Maruco shares ask-only on lower profit forecast.

text.p: Shares in Maruco Co Ltd were ask-only at 2,330 yen at 0119 GMT on last week's downward revision in the company's earnings forecast for the half year ending on February 28, dealers said.
The company said on February 7 it had revised downward its forecast of parent current profit for the half year to 230 million yen from the previous forecast of 2.9 billion yen.
It also revised its forecast of parent current profit for the full year to August 31 downward to 4.27 billion yen from 6.95 billion yen.
